timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Artificial intelligence and decentralized autonomous organizations or
DAO's are the greatest combinations since peanut butter and jelly. It's the year
2025. AI has advanced significantly and blockchain is used across multiple
sectors. Most online communities have transformed into digital tribes living
on blockchain called DAO's. These DAO's operate in line with really intelligent AI
that's able to help these DAO's become truly autonomous. In this AI-driven world
you are the protagonist. The AI in DAO's synergy. In today's day and age where
most people, even myself, have incredibly short attention spans, chat GPD has
been a really useful tool for copying an entire proposal that would take me,
you know, 10 to 15 minutes to read, putting it in chat GPD and actually getting a
concise summary. This is important for DAO's because if we're able to break down
information for everybody to understand we know people are going to make better
decisions and the vote is going to reflect that. Oftentimes when there's things
being discussed in your organization or your DAO you might have a forum where
people can have these discussions. You might open up a discussion only to come
back later a few days and see that there's hundreds of forum posts in there.
Well how do you gain context when there's hundreds of forum posts for you to
catch up on? For most people this is a takes an immense amount of time and they'll
never catch up. So what the AI chatbot could do is summarize all the activity
that's happened in your DAO for the last few days letting you quickly catch up.
Decentralized organizations can be quite chaotic at times even though the
decisions made in the end are something that more people can agree on. It takes
a while to build consensus and for this reason DAO governance tends to be
usually more slow even though better decisions get made and this is somewhat of
disadvantage compared to like startup organizations. It's one of the major
challenges that DAO's face today. But what if you could delegate your tokens to
an AI that already knows how you want to vote? That would increase the
productivity of the DAO because they can make decisions much faster than they're
able to do today. People could come to agreement much faster with their AI
agents voting on their behalf in the way that they would have voted anyway
while also gaining full context to the discussion. You may even be able to
program your AI agent. For example maybe your AI agent automatically votes no on
anything that will dilute your voting power. Low level tasks like Discord
moderation could also be taken care of by AI chatbots who can monitor the
Discord chat and enforce the rules that you set out in your Discord in the
first place. The last one here is AI's role in enhancing the overall user
experience in DAO's. I have to say right now the overall user experience for
DAO's is pretty the learning curve can be pretty steep knowing how quorum works
and what quorum is, what types of proposals you can submit through your DAO, and
even the proposal process itself can sometimes be opaque and not easy for a
newcomer. The AI could be a sort of greeter or guide that you can interface
with when you first join a DAO, especially for a newcomer. It can help you
answer questions, explain the proposal process to you, and even maybe give you
some pointers based on your experience on what proposals you might want to
put forward in the DAO. Now all this superintelligent stuff sounds great but of
course there's some challenges that we have to recognize. Overreliance on this AI
may actually overshadow human input. Much of the activity that happens in DAO's
today is very much interpersonal and if you haven't built up a reputation in
your DAO it can be difficult to gain traction on your ideas. Now what if you have
some incredibly charismatic AI that's able to win over many votes just by its
behavior? This could be a gift and a curse, especially if the AI has hidden
intentions of what it might want to try to accomplish. We've already seen
glimpses of the dark side of AI. That being said, superintelligent AI's across
many DAOs could be a killer combo, especially when AI's are able to identify
other DAOs with similar common interests and combined forces on them.
Imagine you're part of a rainforest conservation DAO. Your job is to help
slow down the deforestation happening in the Amazon rainforest. This AI could
communicate for example with a climate change DAO that is dedicated to
reducing the impact of climate change. The two AI's could come together on a
proposal proposing that both DAOs work together on common ground initiatives.
And in regards to AI's becoming overly charismatic and controlling, this is
where a new concept is being developed called proof of humanity. Proof of
humanity is basically a blockchain based mechanism that'll identify you as a
human being and not as an AI. But of course with any new technology there's
going to be some growing pains. There's going to be mistakes made along the way.
And we're going to have to learn from it. And as we shift into a way from
traditional kinds of labor into these new organizations empowering people around
the globe to come together around common interests. The future is being
written now by us. A global digital tribe of innovators and change makers. And
until next time take care and know the you are appreciated. Peace.

youtube_description:
In this video, we delve into the disruptive power of Artificial Intelligence in decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) and its impact on governance in the crypto space. Blockchain technology and AI are redefining how DAOs are governed, creating new opportunities and challenges for the crypto community. 

Join us as we explore the future of decentralized governance and the role of AI in this rapidly evolving landscape. #crypto #decentralized #AI #governance #blockchain
youtube_title: AI's Disruption: Redefining Governance in DAOs
